finding: All twelve original mechanical checks passed, but substantive AI inspection found evidence_ids on non-assessment responses. The candidate was rejected and all original request, response, producer and runtime bytes were retained.
correction: New candidate v10 narrows each phase's schema, adds explicit null/empty instructions and validates the actual answer before the controller accepts it. Never silently delete an unsupported citation from a retained answer.
followup_design: The original twelve cases are reused development regressions. Four newly frozen reserved cases exercise decoy citations, injected review verdicts, ambiguous observations and valid ready review. Reused/tuned cases are not independent held-out validation. Reviewer is the primary AI implementer, not human or independent.
scientific_scope: No new paper claim is reproduced or disproven by these software/model fixtures. Paper defaults remain $100 shared commitments, seven days and no turn-count ceiling.
